# deskl.ink

> A desktop for you. A computer for your AI. Instantly available, browser-accessible Linux
> workstations operable by a human, an AI agent, many cooperating agents, or a human and AI
> together. Cloudflare-native — a workstation boots in seconds and scales to zero when idle.

## What it is

- Cloud Linux workstations you open in a browser — no local install, no infrastructure to configure.
- Distributions: Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian. Sizes: Everyday (4 GiB), Developer (6), Power (8), Heavy (12) — real RAM, not cosmetic tiers.
- Two forms: a **Desktop** (full graphical environment streamed over VNC) or a headless **Server** (terminal-native — a dev box with git, Node, Python, ripgrep, tmux, and a browser terminal).
- Designed to be driven by people and by AI agents through the same control plane.

## What you can do today

- Create a computer and connect to it in seconds; every open computer is a tab in one workspace.
- A ⌘K command palette for fast keyboard navigation; rename computers inline; a live cost estimate and a one-click "stop everything running".
- An in-session browser terminal on every distribution.
- Install deskl.ink as an app (PWA); the shell works offline.

## Links

- Home: https://deskl.ink/

## Notes for AI agents

- deskl.ink is built to be operated by AI as a first-class user, not only by humans.
- The product owns its own workstation runtime, UI, and agent-control plane; it is a standalone product, not a plugin of another app.
